chapters.title: TREND UP STARTED
chapters.text: The TREND reading (50 bars) reached one sigma up: it reads 84 on the 0–100 scale (84 is one sigma). The trend stays on until the reading crosses back through 50.

chapters.title: PULLBACK ▲
chapters.text: SWING (10 bars) turns against the trend, 38 on the 0–100 scale, and the pocket starts to fill. TREND (50 bars) still reads 88, so the trend stays on.

chapters.title: RESUME LONG · PRIME
chapters.text: The pullback is over: SWING crossed back through 50 and this close held at or above the one before. PRIME: the trend reads one sigma or better and the leg reached two sigma. HOLD 26,528.25, the pullback's low.

chapters.title: RESUME LONG · PRIME
chapters.text: The pullback is over: SWING crossed back through 50 and this close held at or above the one before. PRIME: the trend reads one sigma or better and the leg reached two sigma. HOLD 26,584.00, the pullback's low.
